digest.summary: A tour of Second Brain beyond the core loop: the agent-curated For You feed, the library-aware agent panel that drafts into the Notebook, the User and Memory profile pages, extension capture for logged-in pages, and the plain-file data model that makes analysis safely regeneratable.

highlights.text: Your agent ranks every story against your Radar topics and reading history — and writes a briefing that cross-references your own library.
Ask the agent to draft a brief connecting your recent sources — drafts land in your Notebook.
Originals are never touched, so derived layers are always safe to rebuild.

concepts.definition: The interests the agent uses to rank every story — they also become web search queries.
The sidebar section for agent-drafted documents, beside the Library of captured sources.
The agent's own evolving notes about what you know and care about, editable like any file.

structure: For You feed: sources, radar, briefing

hiddenAssumptions: The user runs a local agent CLI they already trust with their reading material.
potentialIssues: Feed quality depends on radar topics — vague topics produce generic briefings.
needsVerification: Whether the starter RSS defaults match your interests; swap them early in Settings → Feed.
biasIndicators: Product documentation tone — treats agent-drafted output as reliably useful.

connections.details: The introduction covers capture, triage, and reading; this guide adds the feed, the agent panel, profile pages, and the file contract underneath them.
